audit.whatIsWrong: The two chart layers disagree on the last two rows: phases[5].side and phases[6].side both read 'Syndra' while win[5] and win[6] both read 'Aurelion Sol'. Both phases whys describe Aurelion Sol winning those stages ('your E executes the back line of every wave', 'You are the scaling endgame').
audit.why: The full-layer side token contradicts its own why and the content layer. Every piece of prose on both layers agrees the first item onward belongs to Aurelion Sol.
audit.corrected: phases[5].side and phases[6].side set to 'Aurelion Sol' to match win[5]/win[6], which are already correct. Whys need no change — they already describe Aurelion Sol winning.

audit.whatIsWrong: The level-6 spike is written around 'Voice of Light' in whys[4], spikes[1].text and mid. Aurelion Sol has no ability called Voice of Light.
audit.why: Voice of Light was the pre-rework Aurelion Sol ultimate. The current R is Falling Star (1250 range, 120/110/100s, stuns) upgrading to The Skies Descend once enough Stardust is banked. Syndra's level-6 threat is Unleashed Power at 675 range, which executes low targets via the Transcendent passive upgrade.
audit.corrected: Level 6 restated as Falling Star coming online — a 1250-range stun on a 120-second cooldown at rank 1 — against Unleashed Power's 675-range execute.

audit.whatIsWrong: The single decisive interaction of this matchup was never stated: Scatter the Weak (E) is hard CC and both of your channels — Breath of Light (Q) and Astral Flight (W) — are interruptible. Separately the range mismatch is never given: her Dark Sphere is 800 and Force of Will 925, your Q beam is 750, so she wins every poke exchange you accept.
audit.why: ownerKit flags Q and W as 'channel: interruptible — any CC cancels it'. Scatter the Weak is the only hard CC in Syndra's kit and it is 15s flat at every rank at 650 range — it knocks her own Dark Spheres, and enemies hit by a sphere are stunned. That is why the beam must never be channelled inside 650 with W down.
audit.corrected: Written into breakdown.cooldowns (with the 15s/650 numbers), tradeBad, dontsFull[1].d, dontsFull[2].d, report[5].t and early.
sources: enemyKit E text, cd and range

audit.whatIsWrong: Nothing in the matchup mentions that Syndra's Transcendent passive gives Force of Will bonus true damage, so stacking magic resist is the wrong answer.
audit.why: The resistances-invalidated missing interaction. True damage ignores MR entirely.
audit.corrected: Stated in breakdown.feeding and early rather than as a shopping instruction, so it survives as behaviour advice.

audit.whatIsWrong: Widespread misgendering: Syndra is female but tldr, tradeGood, tradeBad, breakdown.wave, breakdown.trading, phases[1].why, phases[3].why, phases[4].why, dosFull[2].t, dontsFull[1].t, dontsFull[2].t, report[0].t, report[3].t, report[4].t, report[9].t and report[11].t all say 'he' or 'his'. audit.corrected: Pronouns corrected in every field edited below, both bleeds replaced with bodies that match their titles, and wants.foe[1] rewritten to the actual mechanic (knock a Dark Sphere into the target for the stun).

audit.whatIsWrong: Mechanical lint pass (tools/matchup-lint.js) over aurelionsol_mid: female enemies referred to as he/him/his in prose fields, breakdown.cooldowns fields containing no cooldown number, Do/Don't bodies that were the generic tradeGood/tradeBad string pasted under an unrelated title, "doubles" magnitude claims with no number, and report[4].t still holding the pre-audit template while breakdown.wave had been rewritten.
audit.why: Pronouns checked against champ-data/champ-gender.js; every flagged pronoun refers to the enemy laner, none to a jungler, so there are no false positives in this set. Riot's description says Aurelion Sol FLIES OVER terrain and creates none. Any generated 'your W walls off their dash' headline for Aurelion Sol is false and must not be shipped.

TWO-LAYER CHART DISAGREEMENT FIXED: phases[5].side and phases[6].side ('Syndra') against win[5]/win[6] ('Aurelion Sol'). Both phases whys already described Aurelion Sol winning, so row and sentence now agree.

PACKET SUSPECT NAME IS A FALSE POSITIVE: packet flags 'Land Scatter the Weak' in wants.foe[1]. The name is correct — Scatter the Weak is Syndra's E. The real defect in that string was the fabricated 'off a nearby wall' mechanic, which I replaced with the actual sphere-knockback stun.

UNVERIFIED / LEFT ALONE: whether Scatter the Weak reliably cancels Astral Flight mid-flight or only prevents the cast. The kit flags W as an interruptible channel and the missing-interactions rule asserts the cancel, so I wrote it in dontsFull[1].d, but I could not confirm it from Riot's text alone — treat that one clause as Medium confidence.

Also left alone: whether Aurelion Sol's Q channel is broken by Force of Will's slow (the kit says 'any CC cancels it' without defining CC). No text asserts either way.
